name: colonies-05-mother-machine
title: Mother machine (viva-munk) — device run + phenotype distributions
description:
Part B (phenotype tier) \u2014 run the canonical viva-munk MOTHER MACHINE (narrow
dead-end channels with a flow channel that washes out cells crossing the top),
populated by viva-munk's simple grow/divide agents: the cheapest rung of the
cost/fidelity tier ladder (simple agent -> growth surrogate -> full WCM). The
simulation runs now and produces (a) an animated GIF of the device running and
(b) distribution figures for the core emergent single-cell phenotypes \u2014 size
at division, inter-division time (birth to division), added length before
division, and the adder size-homeostasis relation \u2014 extracted uniformly by
colony_bench.phenotypes.

This tier establishes the measurement + visualization pipeline against cheap
agents; the phenotype distributions are held for comparison against the WCM
tier (colonies-09) and experimental mother-machine microfluidic data. No
biological conclusion is drawn at the simple-agent tier.

purpose.question:
Do the core emergent single-cell phenotypes — size-at-division,
inter-division time, added length, the adder size-homeostasis relation, and
growth rate — stay measurable when simple viva-munk agents run in the
canonical mother-machine device geometry?
purpose.mechanism:
The mother_machine_document geometry (via v2ecoli.colony_bench.devices) is
populated with simple grow/divide agents; colony_bench.phenotypes extracts
the uniform phenotype panel over the lineage, and the resulting
distributions are the object of study.
purpose.expected_outcome:
The device runs and divides, the running animation renders, and the size-at-
division, inter-division-time, and added-length distributions (plus the adder
plot) are produced and held for later comparison against the WCM tier
(colonies-09) and experimental data. This tier makes no biological claim — it
validates the measurement pipeline against cheap agents.

pipeline_gate.proceed_condition:

extractor stood up in colonies-04.
